items.question: What four challenges did the Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure set for the Nothing Is Impossible Hackathon?
items.gold: Energy consumption in buildings, traffic congestion, flood mitigation, and sustainable aviation fuel.
items.fact: Hackathon's four challenges set by Energy and Infrastructure ministry

items.question: Which government body organised the Nothing Is Impossible Hackathon?
items.fact: Ministry of Possibilities organised the Nothing Is Impossible Hackathon
